files.content:
# Pixel Flood-Fill Toy

An offline color puzzle built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. Choose one of the three colors, then select a tile to recolor its connected region. Regions connect horizontally and vertically; diagonal neighbors do not count. Each successful fill counts as one move. The game announces **One color!** when every tile matches.

Use Tab to move between controls and Enter or Space to activate them. Choose **Start over** to restore the fixed starting pattern.
